protocol: Candidate flags from deterministic title/category conflict patterns; flagged records remain unchanged, pending reviewer decisions after reading abstracts and methods. Other 492 records are NOT cleared; all 500 require individual independent semantic review.
evidence_limits: Title screening is neither a comprehensive abstract review nor trial-design/correction checking. Negative/counterevidence must be evaluated; absence of a flag is not approval.
triage_limitations: Eight flags were individually considered against abstracts, but none has independent human scientific approval. Other 492 entries remain unassessed beyond title/category heuristics. All 500 pending source-only records require the governed independent review and final identity/admission checks.
